title: Why Doom Offered Doctor Strange to Mephisto
description: In Marvel’s Triumph and Torment (1989), Doctor Doom enlists Doctor Strange to free Cynthia von Doom from Mephisto. The rescue turns on a bargain Cynthia refuses and a device Doom hides.
hook: Doctor Doom offered Mephisto a trade. His own mother was the one who turned it down.
payoff: Cynthia's refusal had redeemed her soul. When Strange broke free and they fought Mephisto, she finally escaped to a better afterlife.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Doctor Doom offered Mephisto a trade. His own mother was the one who turned it down.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Years earlier, Cynthia von Doom made a pact with Mephisto. He took her soul, and Victor couldn't get her out.
units.onscreen: THE PACT THAT TOOK HER SOUL
units.visual_query: THE PACT THAT TOOK HER SOUL

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Then Doctor Strange became Sorcerer Supreme and owed Doom a favor. Doom asked him to help bring his mother back.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: They entered Mephisto's realm together. Then Doom offered the demon a trade. He could take Strange instead.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Cynthia saw what her son had done. She refused to go free if it meant leaving Strange behind, and disowned her son.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But Doom had already slipped Strange a device. When Strange was bound, that device gave him a way out.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Cynthia's refusal had redeemed her soul. When Strange broke free and they fought Mephisto, she finally escaped to a better afterlife.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Doom got his mother out. Strange was left wondering if Doom had planned even her rejection.
